Taliyah|jgl.identity: Magic damage mage. Threaded Volley (Q) fires a volley of rocks (weaker on already worked ground), Seismic Shove (W) knocks enemies in a direction, Unraveled Earth (E) lays a minefield that slows (and stuns if the target is knocked into it), and Weaver's Wall (R) creates a huge wall Taliyah can ride. Her passive speeds her up near walls.
Taliyah|jgl.playstyle: Fast-clearing jungler who ganks from long range thanks to her ultimate. Taliyah crosses the map on her wall to gank or cut off a target's escape.
Taliyah|jgl.early_game: Clear very fast with Q (especially on grouped camps). Gank with the E then W combo into the mines: the enemy gets stunned. Use the speed near walls to move faster through the jungle.
Taliyah|jgl.level_2: Unraveled Earth (E). A minefield that slows: your clear gets safer.
Taliyah|jgl.level_3: Seismic Shove (W). First gank: E on the target → W to knock it into the mines (stun) → Q.
Taliyah|jgl.level_6: Weaver's Wall: a giant wall you can ride to cross the map. Use it to gank from far away, cut off a target's escape or split the enemy team in teamfights.
power_spikes: Level 6: long-range ganks on your wall.
First completed item: high clear speed and damage.
Mid game: picks and zone control.
Taliyah|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear, ganks and skirmishes. Taliyah can gank any lane with her ultimate after 6. Control Scuttles, Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. Avoid duels against junglers who dive you (Zed, Kindred, Master Yi, Rengar).
Taliyah|jgl.trading: Ganking: E → W into the mines → Q. Teamfighting: R to split the enemy team, then E and W. Give up on it against junglers who dive you before you can knock them away.
threats: Assassins and divers (Zed, Rengar, Kindred, Master Yi).
CC while you're riding your wall.
mistakes: Knocking the enemy out of your mines or toward their team with W.
Casting Q on already worked ground (less damage).
Cutting off your own team with the wall.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Knock him away with W when he engages.
matchup_notes.Graves: Keep him at range with your mines and W.
matchup_notes.Sylas: Careful: he can steal your wall.
matchup_notes.Kindred: She kites you and scales better: play with your team.
matchup_notes.Zed: He dives you: keep W to knock him away.

Taliyah|jgl.mid_game: Long-range ganks and zone control around objectives.
Taliyah|jgl.late_game: Split the enemy team with your wall, then E and W. Stay behind your frontline.
Taliyah|jgl.behind: Farm and play for a decisive wall in teamfights.
Taliyah|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to farm fast, gank from far away with your ultimate and control teamfights with your wall.
Taliyah|jgl.final_tip: Always knock the target into your mines with W, not away from them.
